lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: They're pouring it on now! Steer it, keep it on them!

lines.template: A sustained attack. My favourite kind. It lasts as long as my attention.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught in the stream! There's no getting out of that by standing still!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: It's soaking right through the guard! Move, move, move!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: All that pressure, and it painted the floor. Lovely floor.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Shot away! Lined up and let go!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Here comes the projectile! Sidestep or swallow it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Right on target! Thread the needle and it lands clean!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Oh, that found them. From that far? Rude.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Wide! That shot sails past and keeps on going!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A spread of shots! Something in there is going to land!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: One shot is a statement. Several shots is a strategy.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The volley connects! Count them later, they all hurt now!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: That was a lot of shots for no hits. Statistically impressive.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Charging it up! You can feel the pressure building from here!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Here comes the big one! Let it rip!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: BOOM! Full blast, full force, full marks!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: That blast sends them flying! What a release!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: All that charge, and it hits nothing! Now they're wide open!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: A huge blast at nothing. Very dramatic for an empty corner.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: And they're off like a shot! Straight at them!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Full speed ahead! That's a rush with bad intentions!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Run through! Didn't stop, didn't slow down, didn't apologise!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Overcommitted! They rushed right past and the door is open!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: They're waiting for it! Swing now and you're walking into the counter!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: A counter stance. The polite way of saying "go on, try it".

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Counter! Read it, caught it, sent it right back!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Owning the floor! That space belongs to one fighter now!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Area control. Like owning real estate, but it hurts to visit.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught in the zone! Get out of there before it gets worse!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A smart reset there, buying a little advantage for the next exchange.

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: A support move. Somebody's playing the long game tonight.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Repositioning! That fighter is going somewhere better!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Not an attack, exactly. More of a relocation with menace.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Stoke opens the stovepipe! It's a flamethrower, folks!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Fire from the furnace! Stoke's sweeping the cage with flame!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Oh, he just breathes fire now. That's new. That's very new.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Still pouring it on! That flame is following them around!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught in the flamethrower! That's Sizzle stacking up fast!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: That's not a tan. That's the flamethrower.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Up and over goes a hot coal! Where it lands, it burns!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He threw a piece of his own furnace. That seems like a heating problem.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Stoke scoops a coal and lobs it! Look out below!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Right on top of them! The coal bursts and the ground starts burning!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The cinder lands on target! And the floor's on fire now too!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Here comes Stoke, all four stacks blazing behind him!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He just left at speed. I felt that from here.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The stacks fire and Stoke launches! Flare Rush!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Boom! The punch explodes and sends both of them flying apart!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Flare Rush connects and it EXPLODES! Both of them go flying!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A ring of flame around the furnace! Step inside at your own risk!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Stoke spins up a ring of fire! Nobody's getting close now!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Burned on the way in! The fire ring does its job!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He is blowing bubbles at a professional fighter. And it is working.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dredge blows a stream of bubbles! Pretty, soggy and right in the way!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Bubbles. In a cage fight. I'm charmed and a little worried.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The bubbles pop on contact! Stay in that and you will be soaked through!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The claw is filling up! That cannon is going to go off any second!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dredge braces and charges the hydro cannon! Get out of the line!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Hydro Cannon! The whole harbour in one shot!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Blasted clean across the cage! That's the hydro cannon, folks!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: And the recoil sent Dredge back too. Everyone's moving tonight.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A whirlpool opens up! It's pulling everything toward the middle!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Swimming lessons, now included with the ticket price.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dragged into the whirlpool! Swim against it or go under!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dredge tucks into his shell. Hits land soft and barely move him now.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A flick of the wing and the wind cuts straight down the line!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He cut the air in half. The air did not see it coming.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Air Slash! A crescent of wind cutting straight across!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Sliced from range! That crescent went straight through!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The Air Slash slices right through! Precision from range!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Feathers in a fan! Five of them, all heading the same way!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A fan of feather darts! Gusto's filling the air!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Those are real feathers. I hope he grows them back.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The feathers stick! That's a few too many darts to dodge!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Gusto whips up a twister! It's travelling and it's hungry!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Swept up in the twister! Around and around and out!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tailwind! Gusto's quicker than ever for the next few seconds.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dozer splits the floor! Rocks are coming up in a line!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He is redecorating. Mostly with rocks.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Rock Slide! The floor tears open in a straight line!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught by the rock slide! And those rocks are staying put!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He dug that boulder up with his face. I have so many questions.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Dozer heaves a boulder! That's a lot of rock in the air!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The boulder lands on them! Flattened!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Quake Stomp! The whole cage jumps!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Down they go! You cannot stand on a floor that is jumping!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Tripped by the quake! Feet off the floor, rear on the floor!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Iron Hide. Little shots are going to bounce right off Dozer now.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Spit, spit, spit! Three darts on the way!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Poison darts! Three quick shots, all of them nasty!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The darts stick! That poison is going to work for a while!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Darts. Venom darts. I'd like to see the inside of that mouth less.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The acid is pouring! Stand in that and the guard melts away!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry sprays acid! Wide, wet and wicked!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Doused in acid! That Gunk is piling on!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry wraps up and squeezes! There's no guard against a coil!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: That is a hug. A very bad hug.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Coil Crush! Squeezed and slammed!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Slurry sheds the skin and everything stuck to it. Clean start.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Thunder Jolt! That bolt is quicker than your eyes!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The bolt lands before they can even flinch! That jolt is building fast!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Discharge! Lightning in every direction!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught in the discharge! Anyone too close just got zapped!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Chain Lightning! Watch it jump!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Chain Lightning connects! And it is looking for someone else to bite!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Wet fighters conduct. I'm writing that down for safety reasons.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A static field crackles to life! Step in there and you'll flinch!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A cold beam from the porthole! Everything it touches slows to a crawl!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The helmet light becomes a beam! Night Shade, and it is cold!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Caught in the ghostly beam! Haunted, and slowing down!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The chain flies out of the dark! Anything it catches comes back with it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: A spectral chain! Knell's reeling somebody in!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Chained! Slowed and dragged right back to the diver!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Three tiny lanterns. Adorable. Terrifying. Mostly terrifying.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Lantern Swarm! Three little lights, all of them hunting!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The wisps find their mark! You can't outrun a ghost light!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: He rings the helmet like a bell! Careful, swinging into that answers back!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The bell tolls! Hit Knell now and you'll hear it twice!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Comet Hook! The gold arc keeps travelling and clips whoever's next!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The hook lands and the shockwave trails right behind it!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Spiral Hook! The aura spins them around and drags them back in!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: He punched them into a spin. I didn't know punches could do laps.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Pressure Palm! The aura leaves his hand and flies across the cage!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Force Palm, point blank! That guard simply stopped existing!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Meteor Hammer! The floor cracks right under that overhead!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Thunder Chop! Quick over the top, and the spark freezes them!

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: The kick throws a shockwave! He's hitting from outside his own reach!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: His kicks travel further than his legs do. Physics has filed a complaint.

lines.speaker: barnaby
lines.template: Iron Shins! He kicks straight through whatever's coming at him!

lines.speaker: kendall
lines.template: Shins of iron. That explains why he walks so loudly.
